name: archi-tts
description: Local Vietnamese (Northern accent) text-to-speech for video dubbing, served over MCP. 15 built-in VieNeu voices; multi-voice scripts with pauses, emphasis, speed, pitch and volume; exports WAV, MP3 and SRT. Runs fully offline on Apple Silicon. Installs the lite edition (~1.3 GB) automatically on first session; OmniVoice voice cloning with emotion clips is an opt-in full edition (~5.3 GB).
